document.abstract: The continued growth of the vidicon type of television pickup camera in both the industrial and studio broadcast fields has precipitated the development of a new series of lenses intended particularly to fulfill the requirements imposed by this type of camera. These lenses have been optically and mechanically designed to provide a high degree of illumination as well as an excellent aberrational correction and level of performance throughout the entire receptor area.
